name: 1D Texture Color Mapping
definition: Colors data in slice, boundary, and Plot3D files by mapping values to a 1D texture map (colorbar) and interpolating colors within the texture, replacing older color cube interpolation.
summary: 1D Texture Color Mapping visualizes scalar fields on surfaces by mapping values to a 1D texture, ensuring pixel-accurate colors and avoiding interpolation artifacts common in standard RGB vertex coloring.
